acl_entries.description: List of ACL entries defining which principals can perform administrative operations. Each entry specifies a principal (or wildcard), permissions (e.g., 'all', 'write', 'read'), and an optional pattern (e.g., '*/admin@REALM' or '*').

items.description: List of allowed administrative operations. 'all' implies full administrative rights.

permissions.description: Set of operations permitted to the principal.

pattern.description: Principal or key pattern to which this rule applies (e.g., '*/*@EXAMPLE.COM', 'admin/*', or '*'). Leave empty or '*' for universal scope.
